data.heading: Twenty-five years of getting the details right
data.description:
Ironclad started as a small job shop in Bhosari. Today our 45,000 sq ft facility in Chakan builds structures, skids, machined parts and automation cells for some of India’s largest manufacturers.

Our engineers design, fabricate, test and install — so one team is responsible from drawing to commissioning.

items.answer: Yes. We build to customer drawings or develop the design ourselves.

items.question: What is your largest capacity?
items.answer: Single assemblies up to 40 tonnes and 18 metres, with in-house crane capacity.

items.answer: Yes. Our site teams erect, commission and train your operators.

items.question: Which industries do you serve?
items.answer: Automotive, pharma, steel, chemicals, food processing and infrastructure.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
